known_issues: If port 4000 is busy, another node process is bound — kill it (netstat | findstr :4000) before npm run boss.
Premium TTS requires ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY — falls back to browser TTS automatically.
Whisper STT endpoint not yet implemented (browser SR works as Layer 1).
Content Studio ccGenAsset is wired to ModelsLab via tkQuickScan path but not yet driving the full asset pipeline.
architecture_notes: Single Node entry: server.js. One port (PORT env, default 4000). One process.
config/boss.config.js = single source of truth for env keys, paths, model policy.
memory/project-state.json = shared handoff for Claude/Bolt/local models.
Cron auto-starts in server listen() → coach tick 30m, GitHub surface 24h.
Conversations auto-persist every 12s to memory/outputs/conversations/<sessionId>.json (always-on Jarvis loop).
